library(glue)

penguins_labeled <- penguins |> 
  mutate(
    label = glue(
      "{species} ({sex} on {island} Island)\n",
      "Bill depth: {bill_depth_mm} mm\n",
      "Bill length: {bill_length_mm} mm"
    )
  )

penguins_plot <- ggplot(
  penguins_labeled,
  aes(
    x = bill_length_mm,
    y = bill_depth_mm,
    color = species,
    shape = species,
    text = label
  )
) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("darkorange", "purple", "cyan4")) +
  theme_light() +
  labs(
    x = "Bill length (mm)",
    y = "Bill depth (mm)",
    color = "Species",
    shape = "Species"
  )

ggplotly(penguins_plot, tooltip = "text")
